data.body: MCP capability tools publish ONE flat schema, so per-operation requirements exist only in the tool description and at call time. On 2026-09-14 an adashi_memory append was rejected for a missing runId although the arguments contained it, and identical arguments succeeded later: the failure is non-deterministic from the caller side and silently loses handover notes. Fixed in src-tauri/src/mcp.rs: append accepts a null or omitted runId and stores operationId as provenance; missing-field errors name the operation and the value to pass; plain domain reasons now travel in the top-level error message while typed conflict JSON keeps its data shape; adashi_memory and adashi_rules descriptions list each operation requirements; agents_template.md documents the append call. Three regression tests and 149 lib tests pass. Deploy: rebuild and restart the MCP server (installed Program Files copy or a running target/release build) and add the append paragraph to each rendered agents.md.
